items.title: Jon Jang interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 17, 2003 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Well thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are at Hamilton College filming for the Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have pianist and composer Jon Jang with me today, and welcome to Hamilton.
I’ve overheard some of your conversations with students and you’ve said some great things. I hope I don’t make you repeat yourself too much.
